title: The Big Score: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Mora didn't want friends, but she didn't mind having someone to watch her back.
"You think because you've mapped the land, you own the land. You own an idea, nothing more."
"I reckon that thing's trying to put me out of a job!" —Bristly Bill, cactusfolk gardener
"How dare these varmints befoul the shining streets of Prosperity?" —Baron Bertram Graywater
"Devour the hope of a world and it will bow before you." —Fomori inscription
The vault's ultimate prize wasn't exactly what Kellan had imagined.
When the vault door opened, ancient war machines rumbled to life.
No one had seen this side of Angeline before, not even her.
